`romfs/images/youtube-logo.png` is the full-color logo with white wordmark
from the [official YouTube brand resources](https://brand.youtube/youtube-logo/)
(`youtube-logo.zip`, `YouTube_Logo/Digital/01 Full Color/yt_logo_fullcolor_white_digital.png`).
The original image is kept unchanged; OKSwitch crops its transparent padding
and downsamples it with area averaging when loading the interface.
